stories.title: Forgotten Island - Exclusive Behind-the-Scenes Clip - IGN
stories.summary: Don't miss this exclusive behind-the-scenes clip from Forgotten Island, the animated film from DreamWorks Animation making its home debut exclusively on digital platforms on October 27, 2026. On their last night before embarking on separate life paths, best friends Jo and Raissa find a mysterious portal that transports them to Nakali, a mythical island filled with magical creatures they learned about from their Filipino families. As Jo and Raissa search for a way home, they discover their memories are at risk. Will they find a way off the island before they forget each other forever? Join in on the most vibrant journey with Jo and Raissa as they befriend Filipino mythological creatures and search for their missing memories to get back home. Forgotten Island is written and directed by Academy Award nominee Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado and is produced by Academy Award nominee Mark Swift, the filmmaking team behind Puss in Boots: The Last Wish. Forgotten Island is now playing in theaters.DreamWorks Animation’s Forgotten Island is distributed by Universal Pictures.
